title: {{NAME}} and the Lost Unicorn's Sparkle
moral: When you are kind and brave, you can help a friend shine again.

pages.content: {{NAME}} walked into a big magical forest. The trees had pink flowers. Little rabbits and foxes played in the grass. In the middle of the forest was a pretty castle. A unicorn stood near the castle gate. The unicorn was all white, but her horn had lost its sparkle.

pages.content: {{NAME}} ran up to the unicorn. The unicorn's eyes were full of tears. 'My sparkle is gone,' said the unicorn. 'I cannot make rainbows any more.' {{NAME}} felt very sad for her. 'I will help you find it,' said {{NAME}}.

pages.content: A small bluebird flew down. 'I saw the sparkle!' said the bird. 'A big brown bear took it by mistake!' {{NAME}} and the unicorn ran fast through the forest. They found the bear sitting by a river. He had a bright glowing gem in his paw.

pages.content: {{NAME}} walked up to the bear. 'Excuse me,' said {{NAME}} kindly. 'That sparkle belongs to my friend the unicorn.' The bear looked at the gem. 'Oh! I did not know,' he said. He held it out with a big smile. {{NAME}} took the sparkle and put it back on the unicorn's horn.
